title: FluxCD Multi-Tenancy, Kustomize Controller & HelmReleases
summary: Master CNCF Graduated FluxCD v2: GitRepository sources, Kustomization reconciliation controllers, declarative HelmReleases, notification controllers, and automated artifact updates.
learningObjectives: Configure Flux Source Controller GitRepository resources for continuous artifact packaging.
Orchestrate multi-environment overlays using Flux Kustomize Controller with pruning and health checks.
Manage declarative Helm charts via Flux HelmRelease and HelmRepository custom resources.

curriculumModules.title: FluxCD GitOps Toolkit (GOTK) Architecture
curriculumModules.conceptSummary: Flux is composed of specialized controllers (source-controller, kustomize-controller, helm-controller, notification-controller) communicating via Kubernetes API custom resources (GitRepository, Kustomization, HelmRelease).
curriculumModules.productionArchitecturePattern: Deploy source-controller and kustomize-controller in flux-system with dedicated ServiceAccounts and RBAC impersonation to isolate multi-tenant application boundaries.

curriculumModules.title: Declarative HelmRelease & Multi-Tenant Reconciliation
curriculumModules.conceptSummary: The Flux Helm Controller reconciles HelmRelease resources by fetching packaged Helm charts from HelmRepository or OCI registries, templating values files, and driving Helm releases with automated rollbacks on failure.
curriculumModules.productionArchitecturePattern: Store HelmRelease CRDs alongside values overlays in Git, enabling declarative helm upgrades with automated drift detection and timeout guards.

labs.title: Configuring Flux GitRepository Source & Kustomization Reconciliation
labs.scenario: Set up Flux GitOps reconciliation: create a GitRepository resource fleet-infra in namespace flux-system referencing URL https://github.com/kubelabs/fleet-infra.git and branch main, and configure a Kustomization resource app-stack targeting path ./clusters/staging with interval 5m, prune: true, and sourceRef pointing to fleet-infra.
labs.productionContext: Flux GitRepository and Kustomization resources form the backbone of pull-based delivery, fetching raw git commits as immutable tar artifacts and applying Kustomize overlays.
objectives: Deploy GitRepository fleet-infra in namespace flux-system.
Deploy Kustomization app-stack in namespace flux-system referencing fleet-infra.
Reconcile Kustomization app-stack using the flux CLI.
labs.starterManifest:
apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: GitRepository
metadata:
  name: fleet-infra
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 1m
  url: https://github.com/kubelabs/fleet-infra.git
  ref:
    branch: main
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: app-stack
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 5m
  targetNamespace: default
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: fleet-infra
  path: ./clusters/staging
  prune: true

steps.title: Apply Flux GitRepository and Kustomization manifests
steps.instruction: Save the GitRepository and Kustomization manifests to /gitops/flux-kustomization.yaml and apply to flux-system.

steps.title: Trigger reconciliation with flux CLI
steps.instruction: Run flux reconcile kustomization app-stack to force an immediate reconciliation cycle.

validationRules.description: GitRepository fleet-infra exists in namespace flux-system
validationRules.name: fleet-infra
validationRules.remediation: Create GitRepository fleet-infra in namespace flux-system

validationRules.description: Kustomization app-stack exists in namespace flux-system
validationRules.name: app-stack
validationRules.remediation: Create Kustomization app-stack in namespace flux-system

solutionCommands:

apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: GitRepository
metadata:
  name: fleet-infra
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 1m
  url: https://github.com/kubelabs/fleet-infra.git
  ref:
    branch: main
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: app-stack
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 5m
  targetNamespace: default
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: fleet-infra

  prune: true
EOF

troubleshootingGuide.problem: flux reconcile kustomization command failed or was not executed.
troubleshootingGuide.cause: Command not run in terminal session.
troubleshootingGuide.solution: Execute flux reconcile kustomization app-stack in the terminal.

labs.title: Declarative HelmRelease Management with Flux Helm Controller
labs.scenario: Configure declarative Helm management in Flux: deploy a HelmRelease resource redis-cache in namespace flux-system with targetNamespace cache-tier, referencing chart redis version 18.0.0 from HelmRepository bitnami, with spec.values.architecture set to standalone.
labs.productionContext: Flux HelmRelease CRDs enable GitOps teams to maintain declarative Helm chart installations with automatic upgrade retries, rollback triggers, and values file validation.
objectives: Apply HelmRelease redis-cache in namespace flux-system targeting cache-tier.
Verify HelmRelease spec parameters (chart name, version, and architecture values).
labs.starterManifest:
apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2beta1
kind: HelmRelease
metadata:
  name: redis-cache
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  targetNamespace: cache-tier
  chart:
    spec:
      chart: redis
      version: "18.0.0"
      sourceRef:
        kind: HelmRepository
        name: bitnami
        namespace: flux-system
  values:
    architecture: standalone

steps.title: Create namespace cache-tier
steps.instruction: Create the destination namespace cache-tier where Redis will be deployed.

steps.title: Apply HelmRelease manifest
steps.instruction: Save and apply the HelmRelease specification for redis-cache to namespace flux-system.

validationRules.description: HelmRelease redis-cache exists in namespace flux-system
validationRules.name: redis-cache
validationRules.remediation: Apply HelmRelease redis-cache in namespace flux-system

validationRules.name: redis-cache
validationRules.remediation: Set spec.targetNamespace: cache-tier in HelmRelease redis-cache

solutionCommands:
cat << 'EOF' > /gitops/redis-helmrelease.yaml
apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2beta1
kind: HelmRelease
metadata:
  name: redis-cache
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  targetNamespace: cache-tier
  chart:
    spec:
      chart: redis
      version: "18.0.0"
      sourceRef:
        kind: HelmRepository
        name: bitnami
        namespace: flux-system
  values:
    architecture: standalone
EOF

troubleshootingGuide.problem: HelmRelease missing or wrong target namespace.
troubleshootingGuide.solution: Verify spec.targetNamespace: cache-tier is specified in HelmRelease.

assessmentQuestions.question: In FluxCD v2, which controller is responsible for fetching git repositories and compressing them into tar.gz artifacts in memory?
assessmentQuestions.explanation: The source-controller acquires external artifacts (GitRepository, HelmRepository, OCIRepository, Bucket) and exposes them as immutable tarballs for other controllers.

assessmentQuestions.question: What happens when prune: true is set on a Flux Kustomization resource?
options: Flux automatically deletes inactive Docker container images on worker nodes.
Flux garbage collects Kubernetes resources that were previously applied by the Kustomization but have since been removed from the Git repository.
Flux cleans up old git commit histories in the remote repository.
Flux reduces the replica count of deployments during off-peak hours.
assessmentQuestions.explanation: With prune enabled, Flux ensures true GitOps synchronization by deleting live cluster resources when their manifests are removed from the Git source repository.
